title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
sourceTitle: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
synopsis: A clinic that erases people, a man who would rather keep the wound, and a beach in winter where someone said meet me.

nodes.text: A morning that doesn't make sense, a train you take instead of the office.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heart.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Tired—follows you into whatever comes next.

The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You take her hand on the porch and you both go inside and you do not promise to do better, only to keep going at all.
You take the train back to the city and you do not call her, and on the way home you write everything down and you save it, this time, on paper.
A summer at Montauk a year later, both of you tan, both of you forgetting in better ways, both of you remembering, finally, who you are.
